exposure.needed: whether windows pods are launched on instance types that are not present in the vpc resource controller config

consequence.statement: Windows pods that previously failed to launch when their instance type was not in the vpc resource controller config will now launch successfully.
consequence.remediation: No operator action required; the fix is included in this release.

assertion.statement: Karpenter v1.0.0 fixes a failure launching Windows pods when the instance type is not in the vpc resource controller config.
